stories.title: Visite du pape à Metz : dialogue interreligieux, discours sur l'Europe, dernière messe... Suivez la dernière journée du voyage de Léon XIV

en.title: Pope's visit to Metz: interfaith dialogue, speech on Europe, final mass... Follow the last day of Pope Leo XIV's trip
en.summary: The Pope concludes his French visit in Moselle on Monday, where he will meet representatives of major religious groups, deliver a speech, and celebrate a final mass.

stories.title: Visite du pape en France : revivez la visite de Léon XIV dimanche à Lourdes

en.title: Pope's visit to France: relive Leon XIV's visit to Lourdes on Sunday
en.summary: Following two days in Paris that drew over one million people, Pope Leon XIV continued his French visit in Lourdes on Sunday with a mass and a meeting with victims of sexual violence in the Church.

stories.title: La droite conserve sa majorité, le RN obtient un groupe, un premier élu LFI… Ce qu'il faut retenir des résultats des élections sénatoriales 2026

en.title: The right retains its majority, the RN obtains a group, a first elected LFI member... What to remember from the results of the 2026 senatorial elections
en.summary: In senate elections where approximately half the seats were renewed, the political balance remained largely unchanged. The RN surpassed ten senators while LFI succeeded in electing one of its candidates.

stories.title: Visite du pape à Lourdes : sur les violences sexuelles, Léon XIV appelle l’Eglise à continuer « la recherche de la vérité, la justice, le pardon, la réparation »

en.title: Pope's visit to Lourdes: on sexual violence, Leon XIV calls the Church to continue "the search for truth, justice, forgiveness, reparation"
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV met with victims of sexual violence in the Church, acknowledging its systemic nature. While victims and associations welcomed his words, many are calling for concrete actions to follow.

stories.title: "On a senti un pape authentiquement à l'écoute" : les victimes de violences sexuelles dans l'Eglise rassurées après leur rencontre avec Léon XIV

en.title: "We felt a pope genuinely listening": victims of sexual violence in the Church reassured after their meeting with Leon XIV
en.summary: Seven victims met with the Pope for nearly two hours to discuss their experiences of sexual violence within the Church.

stories.title: A Lourdes, le pape condamne l’euthanasie et invite l’Eglise à poursuivre la lutte contre les violences sexuelles

en.title: In Lourdes, the pope condemns euthanasia and urges the Church to continue fighting sexual violence
en.summary: During a visit to Lourdes on September 27, Pope Leo XIV condemned legislation on euthanasia adopted by Parliament in July and called for continued efforts against sexual abuse within the Church, meeting with seven victims.

stories.title: Cinq personnes arrêtées en Angleterre après un "incident majeur" près d'une base militaire utilisée par l'armée américaine, la police antiterroriste saisie

en.title: Five people arrested in England after "major incident" near military base used by US military, counterterrorism police involved
en.summary: Five individuals were arrested in England near a US military base, suspected of breaching explosives laws. Counterterrorism police have taken over the investigation.

stories.title: Au Royaume-Uni, des arrestations après un «incident majeur» près d’une base utilisée par l’US Air Force

en.title: In the United Kingdom, arrests after a "major incident" near a base used by the US Air Force
en.summary: Five people were arrested Sunday near Fairford Air Base for alleged violations of explosives laws. Counterterrorism police are conducting the investigation.

stories.title: Cinq hommes arrêtés au Royaume-Uni près d’une base militaire utilisée par l’aviation américaine, Donald Trump affirme qu’ils voulaient causer de « gros dégâts »

en.title: Five men arrested in the United Kingdom near a military base used by American aviation; Donald Trump says they wanted to cause "major damage"
en.summary: Five men were arrested near a Royal Air Force base in Fairford, where bomb disposal experts inspected vehicles and nearby homes were evacuated according to Gloucestershire police.

stories.title: Visite du pape en France : bain de foule, pèlerins malades et victimes de violences sexuelles au programme de Léon XIV

en.title: Pope's visit to France: crowds, sick pilgrims and sexual abuse victims on Leo XIV's schedule
en.summary: The Pope continues his French visit with a Sunday in Lourdes, where he will meet seven victims of sexual abuse within the Church, an encounter expected to draw significant scrutiny.

stories.title: Le Pape Léon XIV attendu à Metz, après sa visite à Paris et Lourdes

en.title: Pope Leo XIV expected in Metz after visits to Paris and Lourdes
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV will travel to Metz on Monday morning for the final stage of his visit to France, which will have a more European and interreligious focus.

stories.title: Visite du pape en France : avez-vous été touché par les messages de Léon XIV à Paris et Lourdes ?

en.title: Pope's visit to France: were you moved by León XIV's messages in Paris and Lourdes?
en.summary: The Pope delivered messages during his visits to Paris and Lourdes in France, prompting reflection on their impact among the public.

stories.title: Spatial : comment la Commission européenne veut gérer les lancements européens (3/3)

en.title: Space: how the European Commission wants to manage European launches (3/3)
en.summary: The European Commission plans to coordinate and consolidate satellite launch services for EU programs and interested member states starting in 2028 through its space agency in the next budget period.

stories.title: Bernard-Henri Lévy : « Vingt fois dans ma vie j’ai voulu arrêter d’être Solal ! »

en.title: Bernard-Henri Lévy: "Twenty times in my life I wanted to stop being Solal!"
en.summary: Bernard-Henri Lévy is releasing his Provisional Memoirs on October 1st, presenting a version of himself less burdened by the public persona that has long defined his image.

stories.title: Valdunes : un nouveau prêt de l’État pour la dernière usine de roue ferroviaire

en.title: Valdunes: a new state loan for the last French railway wheel factory
en.summary: The French government has released an additional 1.5 million euros to support Valdunes, the country's sole manufacturer of railway wheels. The company has been operating below capacity since its acquisition by Europlasma two and a half years ago.

stories.title: Cuivre : en route vers les 15 000 dollars la tonne ?

en.title: Copper: heading towards 15,000 dollars per tonne?
en.summary: Copper prices are approaching 15,000 dollars per tonne, a level considered ambitious a year ago. An accident at the world's largest mine, declining Chinese stockpiles, and potential US tariffs are driving the surge.

stories.title: Sénat : quel poids dans les débats économiques ?

en.title: Senate: what weight in economic debates?
en.summary: The renewal of 178 Senate seats on September 27 highlights the chamber's role in economic discussions. While the Senate does not decide alone, it effectively defends local finances and brings issues to public debate.
